responsibility: This definition module declares the DynamicStrings-based interface for accessing process command-line arguments. It belongs to the gm2 argument-handling layer and exports GetArg and Narg so callers can retrieve argv elements as newly created String objects instead of copying into fixed character arrays, complementing the lower-level Args module.
same_name_distinction: This .def file is the interface half of the SArgs pair: it only declares the String-returning GetArg and Narg procedures, whereas SArgs.mod contains the UnixArgs/argv pointer arithmetic and DynamicStrings construction used to fetch process arguments.
